calibration_method: Paper Algorithm 1 adjusted empirical tail-risk quantile search; not delta-based RCPS

calibration.procedure: paper Algorithm 1 adjusted empirical tail-risk binary search
calibration.assumption: Quantile response should be monotone; shared weights do not strictly enforce it

evaluations.notes: No learned q selector, width loss, or median anchoring. Calibration uses raw predictions; both raw and clipped test metrics reported. Crossing is measured, never silently sorted.
